candidate_identity.identity_basis: exact source segment bytes; interpreter-version independent

claim_ceiling: Four frozen candidates on parity-3, on each recorded host and interpreter envelope, using finite observed deployment envelopes and exact validated opcode counts. No universal family winner, no all-architecture optimization, no cross-host replication, no development-cost advantage, no claim about any substrate other than the recorded CPython envelopes, and no representative intelligence claim.

measurement_schedule.candidate_order: rotate base order by block modulo 4; reverse base order on odd groups of 4

registered_replication_expectation.epistemic_status: Mixed and separated on purpose. P1 and P3 were already confirmed at freeze time by the V6 instrument self-test, which times nothing; see prior_diagnostic_knowledge. They are retained as a record of the reasoning, not as open predictions. P2 is the only genuinely prospective claim: no timing measurement has ever been executed on CPython 3.13 under any registration, so the 3.13 wall and process envelopes, and therefore the 3.13 verdict, are unmeasured at the time of this freeze. The V1, V2, V4 and V5 outcomes on other interpreters were read.
registered_replication_expectation.falsifier: P1 fails if the gate still refuses 3.13. P2 fails if a neural candidate survives on any envelope, if any envelope abstains, or if two validating envelopes disagree. P3 fails on any count or ordering other than those stated. A protocol, identity or capability failure invalidates that packet rather than the expectation.
registered_replication_expectation.post_failure_rule: No changes to candidates, schedule, coordinates, scope, selection or instrument after timing. Keep every first-run outcome per envelope, including failures and abstentions.
registered_replication_expectation.prediction: P1, mechanism informed: with priming, the instrumentation gate will pass on CPython 3.13.12, so that envelope will produce a timed packet instead of a refusal. P2, prospective: the CPython 3.13.12 terminal will be DERIVED_NON_NEURAL_AT_REGISTERED_SCOPE and will agree with the 3.11 and 3.12 envelopes. P3, prospective: the 3.13.12 exact opcode counts will be 72 for X_XOR2_V1, 128 for X_LOOKUP8_V3, 288 for N_SUM_THRESHOLD3_V3 and 440 for N_THRESHOLD_DNF4_V1, preserving the cheapest-to-costliest ordering observed on 3.11 and 3.12.

replication_lineage.freeze_boundary: first main commit carrying this V6 source and registration; later source changes require a new version
replication_lineage.historical_packets: V1, V2, V4 and V5 source, registrations, workflows and measured outcomes remain unchanged, including the retained V5 CPython 3.13 refusal packet.
replication_lineage.v6_change: Instrument priming only, plus recording the priming witness and binding candidate identity against both earlier portable harnesses. Every candidate body, the schedule, the resource coordinates, the development boundary and the decision rule are unchanged.

resource_uncertainty_semantics: finite observed block envelope for this registered run on this recorded envelope; no population-confidence or cross-envelope generalization claim
